the fluorination of benzo[j]fuoranthenes at the 4-position results in the production of a compound that exhibits exceptional tumorigenic potency relative to other polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons.
4-fluoB[j]F has an exceptionally high tumor-initiating activity relative to B[j]F and 10-fluoB[j]-F in a mouse skin bioassay.
